findings.title: Removed Test Polyfills
findings.body: The global Jest setup no longer mocks `window.matchMedia`, `setImmediate`, `TextEncoder` or `ResizeObserver`. jsdom does not provide `matchMedia` or `ResizeObserver`, and `TextEncoder` may be missing in the jsdom environment. Any existing test that renders components using these APIs will now throw errors such as `window.matchMedia is not a function` or `ResizeObserver is not defined`. Blueprint and Radix components use some of these. This breadcrumb refactor does not appear to need the removal.

findings.title: rootId Ignored
findings.body:
`rootId` is still a required prop but is never used. All crumbs are passed through unfiltered. When the explorer is scoped to a sub-folder, `path_collection` includes ancestors above that root, and they will now appear in the dropdown and can be navigated to. The rewrite also changes behavior in two other ways:
- Every crumb except the last is always collapsed into the dropdown, regardless of `isSmall` or available width.
- The current (last) folder is always rendered as a clickable button, so clicking it re-navigates to the same folder.

findings.title: Compiled Artifact Committed
findings.body: This is TypeScript compiler output (`__assign`, `__createBinding`, `exports.render`) committed next to the existing `testing-library` source. Imports like `../../../../test-utils/testing-library` may resolve to this stale `.js` file instead of the TS source, depending on the order of `moduleFileExtensions`. Later edits to the real wrapper would then be silently ignored in tests. This file looks like an accidental `tsc` emit and should likely be removed.

findings.title: Security concerns
findings.body: Access scope bypass (uncertain): `Breadcrumbs` no longer uses `rootId` to filter out ancestor folders. If the host app restricts the explorer to a sub-folder, users may see and navigate to parent folders above the configured root via the dropdown. This assumes the previous implementation filtered by `rootId` and that the API returns ancestors above it; please verify.
